'''''Tolpis succulenta''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Asteraceae]] native to the Portuguese archipelagos of the [[Azores]] and [[Madeira]]. It inhabits all islands (excluding the [[Savage Islands]]).<ref>{{cite web |title=Tolpis succulenta (Dryand. in Aiton) Lowe |url=https://acores.flora-on.pt/#/1tolpis+succulenta |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=2 February 2022}}</ref><ref name="siaram">{{cite web |title=Tolpis succulenta (Dryand. in Aiton) Lowe (ASTERACEAE) - Visgo |url=http://siaram.azores.gov.pt/flora/flora-vascular/visgo/1.html |website=siaram.azores.gov.pt |access-date=2 February 2022}}</ref>

==Description==
[[File:Tolpis succulenta 04.jpg|thumb|left|Inflorescence]]
''Tolpis succulenta'' is a [[perennial plant]] and can reach more than {{Convert|40|cm|in|abbr=on}} in length. Older individuals present a woody base. Its leaves are glabrous and toothed. It has yellow flowers scattered along the stems.<ref name="siaram" />
